name: Cover 0 Max All-Out Blitz
formation: 7-Up Zero Mug vs 11P Gun Trips Left

summary.motive: Overwhelm 5- and 6-man pass protections on critical 3rd & long downs by sending 7 rushers while playing tight press-man coverage without safety help.
summary.keyDefender: SS (Unblocked 7th Edge Rusher) & FS (Press-Man DB on Slot H)
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive math guarantees at least 1 free rusher against 6-man protections, arriving at the QB before any route beyond 3 yards can develop.
summary.failureMode: A missed tackle on a quick boundary hitch/fade or an elusive QB breaking the first tackle into a completely vacant secondary.

beats.title: 7-Up Diamond Alignment (No Deep Safety)
beats.text: Spagnuolo crowds the line with 7 potential rushers and zero deep safeties, forcing a pure 1-on-1 man match across the field and demanding an immediate hot throw from the QB.

beats.title: All 7 Rushers Ignite Simultaneously
beats.text: Every defender at the line rushes! With the offensive line and RB only able to account for 6 blockers, Strong Safety (SS) bursts completely unblocked off the edge.

beats.title: Man-Press Suffocates All Hot Routes
beats.text: The QB looks to release the ball instantly on a quick slant, but FS and RCB have aggressive inside press-man positioning, giving the receivers zero immediate separation.

beats.title: Violent QB Collapse & Incompletion
beats.text: SS and WILL crush into the quarterback in under 1.6 seconds, forcing a fluttering, off-balance throw that hits the dirt harmlessly.

relations.tell: All 7 front defenders rush at snap with DBs pressing at 1 yard depth and no safety retreating deep
